items.title: Creator-commerce triptych - browse videos, trending products, tools
items.description: Three light screens of a creator-commerce app: 'Browse videos' (creator clips with sales sparklines), 'Trending products' (product cards with revenue/sold stats) and 'Tools' (Sandbox 'create a board', Script Viewer 'view the transcript or AI summary of a TikTok'). A video-to-shop analytics suite, not a finance app.

items.title: 'Shop smarter' violet onboarding - splash, account, sign-up
items.description: Three violet onboarding screens: a SALE illustration of headphones/sneakers with 'Shop smarter and save every time.', an 'Aiden Scott' account screen (Active Rides, Hotel Compare, Refer & Earn, Support, FAQs), and a 'Shop smarter' sign-up (Continue with Google/Apple, Full name/Email/Password, Create Account).

items.title: Personal finance triptych - balance, analytics donut, AI coach
items.description: Three soft-gradient finance screens for Abdullah Al Mamun: 'Total Balance $12,750' with overview tiles and transaction history, 'Analytics $3,480' with a spending donut and trend line, and 'AI Finance Coach - Hi Lois, let's manage money smarter.' with prompt chips and a voice bar.

items.title: Travel triptych over an aerial-coast photograph
items.description: Three frosted screens over a turquoise aerial coastline: 'Plan Book and Experience Seamless Travel!' topo panel, a Dhaka Bangladesh search home with destination stack, and 'Ticket Reservation - Select Flight' (Emirates CDG→DXB 7:25-15:35, Skyway LAX→JFK 8:45-16:20).

items.title: 'Ask a Question' homework scanner - type, scan, submit
items.description: Three screens of an AI study helper: 'Ask a Question' with a robot mascot and orange compose bar, 'AI Scanner - Scan Your Question' over a photographed maths sheet at 75%, and a full form (Subject, Additional Notes, orange Submit Question). A homework-scanning flow, not a travel app.

items.title: Monochrome focus/spending trio - bars, block ring, dot year
items.description: Three stark black-on-white screens: 'Total Spending $120.38' with a bar chart and latest transactions (Spotify, Groceries, Uber, Dining out), 'You've been blocking for 1h 41m 1s' ring with Unblock Apps, and a '72% 2026' halftone dot-grid year view. A monochrome screen-time/spending concept.

items.title: VELTO finance triptych - login, balance bars, analytics
items.description: Three VELTO screens: 'Smart Finance for a better tomorrow' with Google/Apple buttons, 'Welcome back' Total Balance $1,9298.79 over a bar chart with Send/Receive/Top Up and Accounts (Main $25,640, Savings $17,200), and 'Analytics' with net-worth figures and a colourful Spending Overview. A banking marketing trio.

items.title: ResolveAI support dashboard - resolution rates and knowledge gaps
items.description: A light 'ResolveAI' dashboard: green '84.8% Resolution rate', blue '72.4% AI resolution', yellow '18.6% Human handoff', 143 Unresolved, 142 Knowledge gaps, 'Handoff reasons 4,821' bar list, an Improvement loop funnel and Top knowledge gaps chips. An AI-support ops board.

items.title: Reading-app paywall - 'Before' dense vs 'After' friendly revamp
items.description: A labelled Before/After of a kids' reading app store page: Before shows dense purple/yellow screens ('Teach Your Child to Read', 'From ABC to I Can Read!'); After shows airy blue screens with a monster mascot ('Teach your child to read', 'Read your 1st book in 10 lessons', 'Loved by over 2 million parents'). A store-listing revamp comparison.

items.title: Doseback onboarding - 30% pricing, ready state, invite friends
items.description: Three dark-green Doseback screens: '30% - Get 12 months for the price of 6' (Yearly $2.49/mo, Monthly $12.99, Continue), 'Your Doseback is ready!' (Set up my first plan), and 'Invite Friends' (Share, shows your invite). The same onboarding trio as IMG-0290 in the Dosebank family.

items.title: Dorcas smart home - 'Keep your home running' voice-first
items.description: A light home-services screen: 'Good morning, Dorcas', a black 'Keep your home running - Water, power, gas & repairs all in one place' card with green orbs, a mint 'Need something else? Tell us what you need' search row and 'What's running low?'. A voice-first household hub.

items.title: Dark wallet walkthrough - markets, buy, sell, send
items.description: Four light-on-dark wallet screens: a Markets coin list, 'Buy' (Amount $11,122.20, You buy 0.12 BTC, Select payment option $24,002.30, Confirm purchase), 'Sell' (You are selling 0.00 BTC, You will get $0.00) and 'Send' (Choose & paste your address, Enter your email). A complete trade flow.

items.title: Voice-model audit table - included models with usage columns
items.description: A dark 'Included models' table (Kai v1.1, Metabio M5, GSAI 0.2 Plus, DeepGram v4 Flash, Maya+Q 3 Flash...) with per-model orange/yellow usage bars and twin value columns (minutes, price), a Usage Limits button and 'View all 30 models'. The pricing/models screen of the dubbing studio.

items.title: Cloned voices - three radial voice cards with speaking share
items.description: A dark 'Voices - Ep. 14 - 3 cloned - en-MX' screen: three radial-burst cards (Ana Reyes Ndoa-warm 4:38, Marco Vidal Niños-deep 3:52, Yuki Sato Lumina-bright 2:26), an 'Add voice' button and a Speaking share bar (Ana 38%, Marco 32%, Yuki 20%, Narrator 10%). A voice-casting board, not a habit tracker.

items.title: Dubbing output analytics - 412 minutes across 3 languages
items.description: A dark 'Output - minutes delivered last 14 days' board: 412 minutes (+18%), Languages 3 all live, Avg Turnaround 6m, and a stacked 'Minutes per day' bar chart (Spanish 188, French 142, Japanese 82, 412 total, target 20m). Delivery analytics for the dubbing studio.

items.title: Dub settings - lip sync, pace, targets and voice mode
items.description: A dark 'Dub settings - Ep. 14 - 3 targets' panel with 128 credits: Lip Sync toggle, Pace 1.04, Keep background music 70%, Pitch -2 st, Smooth speech, Normalise loudness; Dub to Spanish/French/Japanese; Voice mode Clone/Library/Studio; Source language English; Start dub. A dubbing config sheet, not editor settings.

items.title: Voice library - empty state with record/upload/from-video
items.description: A dark 'Voice library - 0 of 5 stored voices' screen: three 3D cylinders on a dais, 'No cloned voices yet. Clone a voice once and reuse it across every language', and Record (30s in browser) / Upload (wav mp3 m4a) / From video options with a white Create voice button. A voice-capture empty state.

items.title: 'a@h' Episode 2 - near-empty white episode shell
items.description: A mostly blank white screen with an 'a@h' wordmark, 'Episode 2' heading and three empty rounded placeholder cards. A sparse episode shell, likely a loading/empty state.

items.title: Music-social triptych - creator profile, discover, artist page
items.description: Three dark-red music-social screens: a home feed with 'Soul Waves' artwork cards, a 'Discover' page (Popular/Latest, Recommended For You), and 'Lukmon Olabode' artist profile (22.2K Posts, 2.3M Followers, 873K Shows, 220K) with photo grid and Follow/Message. A creator-led music community.

items.title: Dark notes app - capture home, project folder, visual-direction note
items.description: Three black screens of a notes app: 'Capture what matters.' with Quick Note/To-Do/Meetings/Project Ideas tiles and Recent Notes, 'Project Ideas - 12 notes' folder grid, and a 'Visual Direction' note (April 5 2026, Santos project, moodboard thumbnails, Design/Inspiration tags). A dense dark note-taking suite.

items.title: Vanta Ride - search, rider details and weekly ride overview
items.description: Three dark ride-booking screens: 'Vanta Ride - Hello, Alan!' From Madrid To Barcelona with Search and Best Rides, 'Rider details' (David Martinez, verified, 09:30 Madrid→10:45 Barcelona, 2h 15m, Book Seat) and 'Ride Overview' (Tue 16 June 2026 week strip, 32 rides available). A ride-sharing flow, not a wallet.

items.title: Daily horoscope - Libra scales on a dark field
items.description: A dark 'Your daily horoscope' screen: week strip, a line-drawn Libra balance-scale glyph, 'Libra' reading copy ('Focus on one unresolved conversation...'), Discover more button, Share/Save and a Horoscope/Ask AI/Profile nav. A zodiac reading screen.

items.title: Smart Garden AI - sunrise field, welcome, tilted garden map
items.description: Three garden-app screens over a grass field: 'Wheat Spike 20°C' sunrise hero with 'WELCOME TO GARDEN AI', 'Welcome to Smart Garden AI' with My Fields and carrot cards (Grow Healthy Carrots), and a tilted 'My Garden Field' map with Water Depth 80% / Soil 70% tiles. An agronomy assistant.

items.title: French winter onboarding - 'L'hiver est à toi' type-led tiles
items.description: Three bold French onboarding tiles: 'L'hiver est à toi.' with a monochrome mountain photo and '90 jours pour toi' sticker, 'Tu veux changer quoi?' (Mon focus checked, Mon corps, Mes habitudes), and 'Un peu. Chaque jour.' with a yak mascot and 30/60/90 jours selector, each with a white CTA. A typography-led habit app.
